methodology_correction: A successful GitHub commit API lookup (HTTP 200) proves only exact-SHA object presence, not upstream integration. Reachability requires git merge-base --is-ancestor / branch --contains; normalized patch identity requires git patch-id --stable on immutable .patch URLs (verify the 'From <sha>' header: merge commits can return a parent's patch); semantic equivalence requires direct source inspection. Divergence from the pinned master (behind_by>0) is reported explicitly, not collapsed into 'merged' or 'unique'.
sample_selection: deterministic stratified: 12 evenly spaced from the 40 locally present tips and 12 evenly spaced from the 206 locally absent tips; no cherry-picking of outcomes
constraints: no merge, push or upstream submission
limitation: Sample only; inconclusive cases must be preserved and investigated. No legal certification. No PR .patch URL was available: GitHub issue/PR search for the equivalent change returned 0 results, so immutable commit .patch URLs were used and their headers verified.
